claims.quote: A Datalog-style logic layer in `@lionlang/core`. New special forms `relation`, `fact`, `retract`, `rule`, `query`, `why`, `not`, `and`, `or`, and `=`; unbound `"?name"` strings evaluate to logic variables; and pure stdlib functions called on logic variables become filters or computed values. Rules use stratified negation and semi-naive evaluation, are checked for safety when added, and every answer can be explained with `why`. See `packages/examples/logic.json`.

says.statement: Lion includes a Datalog-style logic layer whose relations, goals, and logic variables are ordinary values, written in the same JSON as the rest of the language
